card.summary: The National Prescribed Fire Act of 2025 directs the Department of Agriculture and the Department of the Interior to increase the use of prescribed fires on federal lands over a 10-year period. It establishes programs, funding mechanisms, workforce support, training centers, and cooperative agreements with non-federal entities and Indian Tribes to carry out planned burns while coordinating with air quality agencies to manage public health risks from smoke.
